history.registration_changes: Same frozen seeds, full budgets, estimators and bounds; successor uses isolated same-source CUDA12.8 reference build and reviewed n3 runtime.

limitations: Compatibility applies to the registered finite trajectories; no universal exact-NPT or ergodicity claim.
Theory-target diagnostics remain separate and do not override cross-engine compatibility.
No RDMA/cross-node or non-NEP NPT validation.
NEP5/ZBL evidence is the separately recorded short output/restart contract, not this statistical study.
GPUMD internal clock seed is not observed; distinct UTC launch seconds are conservative isolation evidence.
provenance_note: Numerical summaries copy the one completed frozen report; this index performs no new estimator, bootstrap or statistical look.

review_receipts.documentation: 21 files, 405 local links/fragments, zero broken; git diff --check exit0

relocation.retention_policy: At user request, retain only the final paired-analysis result, registration manifest/protocol and original 18-look index; intermediate execution, migration, audit and snapshot details were removed.
relocation.historical_paths_note: Paths embedded in the final report and one_shot_analysis record describe the original execution layout and are historical facts, not current locators.
